meals.name: Creamy Chicken Tortilla Soup
ings: 1 (10 oz) can Rotel diced tomatoes with green chilies
1 (14 oz) can black beans, drained & rinsed
Tortilla strips, avocado, sour cream, Tex-Mex cheese
steps: Sauté onion in oil over medium-high 5–7 min until lightly browned.
Stir in tomatoes, Rotel, broth, spices, corn, and beans. Increase to high.
Boil, then reduce and simmer lid slightly ajar for 5 min.
Stir in cream and chicken. Warm through 3–5 min. Season and serve with toppings.
meals.label: Meal A

meals.name: Lemon Dill Salmon with Roasted Broccoli & Brown Rice
ings: 1 lemon, half sliced thin, half for juice
2 pouches microwaveable brown rice (8.5 oz each)
Optional: lemon zest, fresh dill, flaky salt to finish
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a large sheet pan with foil.
Toss broccoli florets with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on the sheet pan. Roast 10 minutes.
Pat salmon dry. Rub with olive oil, garlic powder, dill, salt, and pepper. Place on the sheet pan alongside the broccoli. Lay lemon slices on top of each fillet.
Roast 12–14 minutes until salmon flakes easily and broccoli edges are lightly charred.
Microwave brown rice pouches per package directions (about 90 seconds). Fluff and serve.
Squeeze fresh lemon over everything before serving. Finish with a pinch of flaky salt if you have it.
meals.note: 💡 The lemon slices on top perfume the fish as it roasts. If fillets are thick (over 1 inch), add 2 minutes. Broccoli should be in a single layer for good char — use two pans if needed.
meals.label: Meal B

meals.name: Falafel Bowl with Tahini Dressing
meals.meta: ~45 min · Oven or Air Fryer · Serves 4
ings: ½ cup fresh cilantro, ½ cup fresh parsley
1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, ½ tsp cayenne (optional)
½ tsp baking powder, 3–4 Tbsp chickpea flour
2 cups cooked quinoa or brown rice
1 cup diced cucumber, 1 cup cherry tomatoes
½ red onion sliced, 1 shredded carrot, ½ cup hummus
Tahini dressing: ¼ cup tahini, lemon juice, olive oil, water, garlic, maple syrup
steps: Drain soaked chickpeas. Pulse in food processor with cilantro, parsley, garlic, onion, spices, baking powder, and salt. Add chickpea flour until mixture holds together. Chill 30 min.
Shape into balls or patties. Fry 3–4 min per side, or bake 375°F for 25–30 min flipping halfway, or air fry 375°F for 15–18 min.
Cook grains per package. Season with olive oil and salt.
Whisk tahini dressing ingredients until pourable.
Assemble bowls: divide grains and greens, arrange toppings, add 3–4 falafels, spoon hummus, drizzle dressing. Garnish with cilantro.
